title: SAMPLE: Evening feeder outage reported in western Tripoli
summary: A sample electricity note described a feeder outage in western Tripoli. This is not a national generation figure and not a GECOL bulletin.
whatHappened: Residents and a sample neighbourhood committee note described a loss of supply on one feeder in western Tripoli from about 18:00 on 2 September 2026. Restoration was described as incomplete the following morning.
whyItMatters: Local feeder faults change clinic, water-pump and office planning. They should not be read as a statement about national generation.
watchNext: A restoration time that can be marked resolved, or a wider-area report that would change the geographic scope.
confidenceRationale: Local reports agree on timing; no operator confirmation.
